q: What do we know about ds-c25-churn-labels in the churn-2025 project?
a: Churn is no card spend and no payment for N days after the snapshot, built from cards.churn_labels; the 60-day window gives 4.3% churn and the 90-day window 6.8% on the training snapshots.

q: What came of the churn-2025 label window sweep exp-101?
a: exp-101 found 90-day labels add 0.011 AUC (0.704 vs 0.693 at 60 days) but mature a cycle later, so dec-c25-label-60d kept the 60-day window.

q: What does churn-gbm-2025-v2 in the churn-2025 project use for utilisation and recency?
a: It uses feat-c25-util-v2 (trailing 90-day balance over the time-matched limit) and feat-c25-txn-recency with a monotone constraint; app sessions were dropped.

q: What is the current scoring model in the churn-2025 project?
a: churn-gbm-2025-v2, approved by dec-c25-ship-gbm-v2 for the November 2025 cycle; it supersedes churn-gbm-2025 (v1) and has 13 features on 60-day labels.

q: What is the holdout AUC of churn-gbm-2025-v2 on the c25-oot-2024h1 holdout in churn-2025?
Why were app-session features dropped from the churn-2025 production model?
a: After util-v2 went in, app sessions added only 0.001 AUC (0.758 vs 0.757), inside the bootstrap interval, so dec-c25-drop-app-sessions removed them.
